week.name: Thursday
week.short: Chance Light Snow then Rain And Snow
week.detailed: A chance of snow before 8am, then rain and snow likely between 8am and 11am, then rain and snow. Cloudy. High near 43, with temperatures falling to around 41 in the afternoon. South southeast wind 2 to 6 mph. Chance of precipitation is 90%.

week.name: Friday
week.detailed: Rain and snow. Cloudy, with a high near 38. Southwest wind around 6 mph. Chance of precipitation is 90%. New snow accumulation of less than one inch possible.

week.name: Saturday
week.short: Slight Chance Light Snow then Partly Sunny
week.detailed: A slight chance of snow before 11am. Partly sunny, with a high near 36. Chance of precipitation is 20%. Little or no snow accumulation expected.

week.name: Sunday
week.detailed: Mostly cloudy, with a high near 39.

week.name: Monday
week.detailed: A chance of snow. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 37. New snow accumulation of less than half an inch possible.
week.night_short: Slight Chance Light Snow then Mostly Cloudy

week.name: Tuesday

week.name: Wednesday

nws_alerts.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 18 at 10:38PM MST until November 21 at 11:00AM MST by NWS Salt Lake City UT
nws_alerts.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected. Total snow accumulations between 10 and 20
inches for the Wasatch Mountains with locally higher totals across
the upper Cottonwoods. Total snow accumulations between 5 and 10
inches for the Western Uinta Mountains.

* WHERE...The Wasatch Mountains, and Western Uinta Mountains.

* WHEN...From 11 AM Thursday to 11 AM MST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Winter driving conditions are expected.

discussion.key_messages: - A longer duration storm will come through the area in pieces from early Thursday morning through Saturday morning bringing widespread accumulating snow to the mountains with the highest snow totals across the northern mountains. - Valley snow will be possible mainly Friday evening into Saturday morning. - Freezing temperatures are increasing in probability for the Virgin River corridor near Zion National Park Saturday and Sunday mornings.
